把手的动作存成弹性能: Stores your winding as elastic energy
上链时，表冠带动棘轮，让发条卷紧。运行时，外端推动发条盒转动。盒上的 96 个齿: The crown turns a ratchet to wind the mainspring. As it unwinds, its outer end turns the barrel. The 96-tooth barrel meshes with a 12-leaf center pinion: one barrel turn produces eight center-wheel turns in the opposite direction.
把动力交给分针与后面的轮系: Drives minutes and the rest of the train
中心轮每小时一转。80 个大齿推动第三轮的 10 齿小轴，速度增加八倍。大轮和小: The center wheel makes one revolution per hour. Its 80 teeth drive the third wheel’s 10-leaf pinion eight times faster. Each wheel and its pinion share a rigid arbor and always rotate at the same speed.
第三轮以中心轮八倍的速度转动。75 个齿再推动第四轮的 10 齿小轴；两级合起来: The third wheel turns eight times faster than the center wheel. Its 75 teeth drive the fourth wheel’s 10-leaf pinion. Together these stages make the fourth wheel exactly 60 times faster than the center wheel.
秒针所在的那一根轴: The arbor that carries the seconds hand
第四轮每分钟一转，小秒针固定在它的轴上。它的 96 个齿啮合擒纵轮的 6 齿小轴: The fourth wheel turns once per minute and carries the small seconds hand. Its 96 teeth mesh with the escape wheel’s 6-leaf pinion, giving the final wheel 16 revolutions per minute.
把连续的扭矩分成一小拍一小拍: Meters continuous torque into discrete beats
15 枚轮齿交替被两块红宝石瓦锁住。每个半摆放行半个齿距；一整圈需要 30 拍。: Fifteen teeth are alternately locked by two ruby pallets. Each half-swing releases half a tooth pitch; a full turn takes 30 beats. Sixteen turns per minute × 30 beats gives eight beats per second, or four complete oscillations.
15 齿 · 每分钟 16 转 · 每拍半个齿距: 15 teeth · 16 rpm · Half a tooth per beat
交替锁住、放行，再推动摆轮: Locks, releases and impulses the balance
摆轮的冲击钉进入叉口，带动叉身解锁。擒纵轮齿沿冲面推动宝石瓦，能量经叉口返回摆轮: The balance impulse pin enters the fork and unlocks a pallet. An escape tooth pushes along the pallet’s impulse face, returning energy to the balance. The opposite pallet then locks the train while the balance swings freely. Contact geometry and the release window here are kinematic illustrations.
决定时间流逝的节拍: Sets the rhythm of the movement
摆轮的转动惯量与游丝的扭转刚度共同决定频率：f = √(κ/I) / 2π。增大: Balance inertia and hairspring stiffness set frequency: f = √(κ/I) / 2π. More inertia gives a slower oscillation. This train is calibrated for 4 Hz; changing the inertia leaves the tooth ratios unchanged, so the indicated time gains or loses.
这根细弹簧的内端连在摆轴，外端固定。摆轮往复时，游丝收拢又舒展。相同截面与材料下: The inner end is attached to the balance staff and the outer end is fixed. It breathes as the balance swings. With material and section held fixed, a longer active length reduces stiffness, and frequency falls as 1/√length. This is an ideal isochronous oscillator; positional, magnetic and thermal effects are omitted.
内端随摆轴转 · 外端固定: Inner end follows staff · Outer end fixed
表冠通过立轮和上链轮驱动棘轮，棘爪阻止发条轴倒转。按住「转动表冠」可持续上链。2: The stem and winding wheels drive a ratchet; the click prevents the barrel arbor from unwinding backward. Hold “Wind the crown” for continuous winding. Twenty-four reference turns fill the energy store, a deliberate interaction mapping rather than a real calibre’s winding count.
单向棘轮 · 24 次参照转动补满: One-way ratchet · 24 reference turns to full
让时针正好比分针慢十二倍: Makes hours exactly twelve times slower
中心轴带动分针。分针轴的 10 齿推动跨轮的 40 齿，形成 4:1；跨轮同轴的: The center arbor carries the minute hand. A 10-leaf cannon pinion drives a 40-tooth minute wheel; its 12-leaf pinion drives a 36-tooth hour wheel, giving 4 × 3 = 12 reduction. The small seconds hand is driven separately by the fourth-wheel arbor.
让每一根轴守住自己的位置: Keeps the arbors precisely in place
齿轮的两端都需要轴承约束，才能维持啮合。上层夹板与下层主夹板一起定位轮系。拆解时: Bearings at both ends constrain each arbor and maintain mesh alignment. Bridges above and the main plate below locate the train. Exploded parts rise along display axes, not in a service sequence. Some fasteners and supports are repositioned for clarity.
上下支承 · 分层拆解可见: Upper and lower support · Explorable layers
让细小的钢轴在硬而光滑的孔里转: Supports steel pivots in hard, smooth holes
合成红宝石耐磨，适合作为轴孔和擒纵瓦。本模型在主要轴端显示环形孔石，摆轮上方另外: Synthetic ruby resists wear and is used for pivot holes and pallets. Ring jewels mark the main arbors; a shock spring is shown above the balance. Size and colour are slightly exaggerated for legibility. Jewel count is not a measure of movement quality.
把每小时 28,800 次心跳，交给一根指针。: A heartbeat, counted in brass and steel.

参照机芯 · 齿比与节拍严格联动 · 擒纵接触与储能响应为示意: Teaching movement · Exact train ratios and beat counting · Illustrative contact and energy response
40 小时为本设计的参照储能；负载增大会更快耗尽。: 40 hours is this design’s reference store; a higher load drains it sooner.
机芯齿比按 4 Hz 设计。改变游丝或摆轮，指针会走快或走慢。: The train is calibrated for 4 Hz. Change the spring or balance and the hands gain or lose time.
曲线是理想摆轮角度，非麦克风实测。: Trace shows the ideal balance angle, not a microphone recording.
发条的能量已经用完。转动表冠，让机芯重新跳动。: The energy store is empty. Wind the crown to restart the movement.
每对齿轮都把速度乘上自己的齿数比。中心轮、第三轮、第四轮，最后把一小时分成六十个: Each mesh multiplies speed by its tooth ratio. From center to third to fourth wheel, one hour is divided into sixty minutes.
